messages:
olivia: Heads-up: Katana POC reporting weird TTFT tail during simulated user load. Median ~260ms but occasional 2-3.5s spikes. Demo is tomorrow.

olivia: shared gateway snippet:
```
2026-03-24T16:22:11Z TLS: handshake timeout from 10.40.3.14
2026-03-24T16:22:12Z 502 upstream reset id=kt-204
client log: latency=3210ms req=kt-204
```

rajeev: thanks. Two likely culprits: connection churn (TLS handshakes) and a batching window accumulating many short requests into big batches. Also check kv cache hit rate for their common prefixes.

mina: can you get the api_key? Also ask if their gateway supports HTTP/2 multiplexing or if it opens new backends per request.

olivia: api_key katana-poc-44. They replied: managed gateway, opens new connections per request by default.

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T21:17:00 modified batching.short_seq_heuristic in cluster-eu-1 by ci-bot. No rollback found.

rajeev: quick mitigation we can do now: route override to reduce batch_window_ms, cap max_batch_size, enable prefix_kv_cache (short TTL) and bump edge keepalive and idle timeout for that key. I can run it if you approve.

mina: If they can't change gateway, we should also offer a temporary demo burst to avoid throttling. Sales wants estimate before proposing.

rajeev: proposed command (will run once approved):
```
redwood routes update --api-key=katana-poc-44 \
  --set batch_window_ms=2 \
  --set max_batch_size=14 \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.ttl=600 \
  --set edge.keepalive=120s \
  --set edge.idle_timeout=100s
```
I'll monitor for 20m and grab batch_wait_ms distribution.

solutions: I can prepare an 8-prompt prefill and simple instructions to seed the cache 10-20 calls before demo. Also we should suggest they enable keepalive pooling >=8.

olivia: customer cannot change managed gateway settings quickly. They asked whether Redwood can accept TLS-only temporarily (they currently use mTLS and failing cert rotation).

mina: security note: TLS-only for sandbox ok with approval, but require ticket. I'll open SEC-POC-499 and request 24-48h allowance.

devops-bot: config-change 2026-03-24T16:35:05 applied: route_override(katana-poc-44) batch_window_ms=2, max_batch_size=14, prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true ttl=600, edge.keepalive=120s, edge.idle_timeout=100s.

rajeev: applied overrides. Early telemetry: median TTFT ~300ms (slightly higher due to smaller batches) but 95p dropped from ~3.2s -> ~650ms. A handful of ~1.1s spikes remain; looking at traces they correlate with kv_cache_hit=false.

olivia: shared to customer: please run 15 seeded requests from your load generator to warm prefills. They replied they'll do it in 10m.

solutions: uploaded 8-prompt pack and instructions to the customer portal. Prefill recipe: 20 quick calls at T-10, use same prompt template and same user prefix.

mina: pricing for demo burst: 4 hour small dedicated burst to cover peaks ~ $380. Offer: first 4 hours free for POC, then invoice if they continue. Sales ok to offer credit.

olivia: after prefill and overrides, customer reports steady median ~310ms, 95p ~700ms, rare ~1.2s outliers gone. Demo tomorrow confirmed.

rajeev: follow-ups: monitor batch_wait_ms and batch_size distribution for 24h, revert heuristic if regression shows, close SEC-POC-499 when security signs off.

olivia: thanks team, will close after demo. :thumbsup:
